data.title: Velocity is reported as a range, never as an average
data.why: The same reason flow reports percentiles: one number over a handful of sprints hides how much they differ, and that spread is the forecast. A team at 8, 14 and 9 points has a very different next sprint from one at 10, 10 and 11, and an average cannot tell them apart. The response carries low, median and high, and a series shorter than four sprints says so out loud - PMI's Agile Practice Guide puts the settling point at four to eight iterations.
data.rejected: A mean of the last three sprints, which is what Jira's velocity chart shows and what every team then quotes as a commitment
